meta.parties: The Chartered Bank of India, Australia, and China, Ltd. v. Palaniappa Chetty Et Al

rules.statement: A Chetty agent signing on behalf of a firm binds the firm when he prefixes the initials of the firm to his own name, provided he has authority to do so.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am of opinion therefore that in the present case Muttiah Chetty, having been authorized by the power of attorney to sign in the name of the firm, he has properly done so by prefixing the vilasam to his name, and that that signature binds the firm on the note."
